title: Paul McCartney and Nancy Shevell honeymoon in Mustique
content:
Sir Paul McCartney and his new wife Nancy Shevell – now Lady McCartney – have jetted to the Caribbean island of Mustique for their honeymoon.

The couple are staying at Sir Mick Jagger’s beachfront mansion Stargroves, which is normally rented to guests for £10,000 a week.

Jagger’s house has six bedrooms, 25ft swimming pool, floodlit tennis court, private chef and a butler. The McCartneys are past guests at the mansion, which is a popular retreat for celebrities.

The couple flew from London to St Lucia for their four-day honeymoon.
